cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: went to my boss
cues.zh: 我去找老板了

cues.en: and said to him, you know, I'm going to go do this crazy thing and I'm going to start this
cues.zh: 然后对他说，你知道，我要去做这件疯狂的事，我要开始搞这个。

cues.en: company selling books online. And this is something that I had already been talking to him about in a sort of more general context, but then he said, Let's go on a walk. And we went on a two hour walk in Central Park in New York City.
cues.zh: 一家在线销售图书的公司。这个话题我之前已经在更宽泛的背景下和他聊过，但后来他说：“我们去走走吧。”于是我们在纽约市的中央公园里走了两个小时。

cues.en: And the conclusion of that was he said, This actually sounds like a really good idea to me, but it sounds like it would be a better idea for somebody who didn't already have a good job.
cues.zh: 最后他的结论是，他说：“我觉得这想法确实挺好，但它可能更适合那些手头还没有好工作的人。”

cues.en: And he convinced me to think about it for forty eight hours before making a final decision. And so, I went away and
cues.zh: 他劝我在做最终决定前先考虑48个小时。于是我就先回去了，接着……

cues.en: was trying to find the right framework
cues.zh: 当时想找一个合适的框架

cues.en: in which to make that kind of big decision. And, you know, I already talked to my wife about this and she was very supportive and said, Look, you
cues.zh: 来做出那种重大决定。而且，你知道的，我已经跟我妻子聊过这事了，她非常支持，说：听着，你

cues.en: you can count me in 100%
cues.zh: 百分百算我一个

cues.en: whatever you want to do. You know, it's true. She had married this kind of, you know, fairly stable guy and a stable career path, and now he wanted to go do this crazy thing, but she was 100% supportive.
cues.zh: 不管你想做什么。真的，确实如此。她嫁给了一个你知道的、相当稳定的家伙，有着稳定的职业发展，而现在他却想去做这么一件疯狂的事，但她却给予了百分之百的支持。

cues.en: So it really was a decision that I had to make for myself.
cues.zh: 所以这确实是我必须自己做出的决定。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 和

cues.en: the framework I found,
cues.zh: 我找到的这个框架，

cues.en: which made the decision incredibly
cues.zh: 这让这个决定变得不可思议地

cues.en: easy,
cues.zh: 简单，

cues.en: was
cues.zh: 曾经

cues.en: what I called, which only a nerd would call a regret minimization
cues.zh: 我称之为——只有书呆子才会叫的——遗憾最小化策略

cues.en: framework.
cues.zh: 框架。

cues.en: So, I wanted to project myself forward to age 80 and say, Okay, now I'm looking back on my life. I want to have minimized the number of regrets I have. And you know, I knew that when I was 80, I was not going to regret having
cues.zh: 所以我想象自己到了80岁，对自己说：好，现在我回顾自己的一生。我希望能把人生的遗憾降到最低。而且你知道，我很清楚等我80岁的时候，我不会后悔曾经

cues.en: tried this. I was not going to regret
cues.zh: 试过了。我不会后悔。

cues.en: having wanted, you know, trying
cues.zh: 嗯，一直想要，你知道，尝试

cues.en: participate in this thing called the Internet that I thought was going to be a really big deal. I knew that if I failed,
cues.zh: 参与这个叫互联网的东西，我本以为它会非常了不起。我知道如果我失败了，

cues.en: I wouldn't regret that. But I knew the one thing I might regret is not ever having tried. And I knew that that would haunt me every day.
cues.zh: 我不会后悔那件事。但我知道，我唯一可能后悔的，是从没尝试过。而我知道，那会每天折磨我。

cues.en: And so, when I thought about it that way, it was an incredibly easy decision.
cues.zh: 所以，当我那样去思考时，这个决定就变得无比轻松了。

cues.en: And I think that's a very good if
cues.zh: 我觉得这招非常好用，如果你

cues.en: you can project yourself out to age 80 and sort of think, what will I think at that time? It gets you away from some of the daily pieces of confusion. You know, I left
cues.zh: 能把自己投射到80岁，去想“那时我会怎么看？”这能让你跳出日常的各种琐碎困扰。要知道，我离开

cues.en: this Wall Street firm in the middle of the year. When you do that, you walk away from your annual bonus. And that's the kind of thing then the short term can confuse you. But if you think about the long term,
cues.zh: 那家华尔街公司时正值年中。这样一来就等于放弃了年终奖，短期内这类事确实容易让人犯难。但如果放眼长远，

cues.en: then you can really make good
cues.zh: 你就能真正做出

cues.en: life decisions that you won't regret later.
cues.zh: 日后绝不后悔的人生抉择。
